Name: Bara Anthro XL - Furry Characters
Author: ChazzingtonBara
Description:
[size=4]Introduction

THIS MODS IS ENTIRELY MEANT FOR ADULTS 18+, ALL MINORS MUST LEAVE NOW!!!!!!!!! 

﻿Hello Again! We all know why you are here! You would like to fill your Stardew Valley play through with some thiccer furry men (XL EDITION) and I am here to try my best to oblige you. This mod will make All adults in Stardew valley into Bara furry men with base, winter and beach sprites.

﻿I encourage all to comment and message me for suggestions and input, I get a rush of passion for my projects the more interaction I get. Please share and endorse my mods :D

The goal of this mod is hopefully to have more people play Stardew Valley from our community and hopefully they too are inspired to make their own mods.

If you are going to make an edit or any companion mod for this please reach out to me to let me know, some people have taken my work and gotten credit for my mods without notice before and its been discouraging.
 
Currently working on a new project and you can see progress, polls, and banter about the mods. Here is a link to the mod discord https://discord.gg/5xST63aS9H

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Special Thanks

﻿"Entifrisky" also gave a lot of input on the mod and helped provide sprites for this and has been super helpful, PLEASE CHECK OUT HIS MODS AND SUPPORT HIM!!! My Mods work perfect with theirs. Hes also an excellent artist and I implore you to look him up. <3

Also a special thanks to all the OG Furry mods as well as all the dependent mods because this wouldn't have happened without them. <3

Big Thanks to all those who are making companion mods aswell <3

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Contents﻿

This mod entails: The Entirety of The Bara Anthro Collection of multiple characters with the 1.6 update with winter wear. I recommend you grab Enti's mods as well wince they go along with mine
